title: IntGenomicsLab/lrsomatic pipeline parameters
description: Workflow for somatic variant calling of long read data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet with a header row; see the [usage documentation](https://github.com/IntGenomicsLab/lrsomatic/blob/main/docs/usage.md#samplesheet-input) for the columns.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

pon_options.title: Panel of Normals (PON) options
pon_options.description: Options for panel of normals filtering

clairsto_pon_vcfs.description: Path to panel of normals VCF file(s) for ClairS-TO somatic variant filtering

clairsto_pon_flags.description: Population allele matching flags for ClairS-TO PON VCFs (one per VCF, comma-separated)

deepsomatic_pon_vcfs.description: Path to panel of normals VCF file(s) for DeepSomatic --population_vcfs. If not set, uses container-bundled defaults in tumor-only mode, or no PON in paired mode

germline_var_keep.description: Comma-separated list of germline variant callers to use. Valid values: deepvariant, clair. Example: 'deepvariant,clair'

somatic_var_keep.description: Comma-separated list of somatic variant callers to use. Valid values: deepsomatic, clair. Example: 'deepsomatic,clair'

germline_var_combine.description: When two germline callers are used, specifies how to combine them. 'consensus' keeps only variants called by both callers; 'all' keeps all variants from both callers.

somatic_var_combine.description: When two somatic callers are used, specifies how to combine them. 'consensus' keeps only variants called by both callers; 'all' keeps all variants from both callers.

prioritize_caller_germline.description: When both germline callers are used, specifies which caller's format to use for variants called by both. Must be [deepvariant, clair].

prioritize_caller_somatic.description: When both somatic callers are used, specifies which caller's format to use for variants called by both. Must be [deepsomatic, clair].

longphase_options.title: Longphase options
longphase_options.description: Options for Longphase phasing of small variants

longphase_tag_supplementary.description: Whether to include supplementary alignments in Longphase haplotype tagging.

modkit_options.title: Modkit options
modkit_options.description: Options for modkit pileup of base modifications

modkit_args.description: Command line arguments passed to `modkit pileup`. The value replaces the default rather than extending it; the default restricts the bedMethyl output to 5mC calls at CpG sites.
modkit_args.help_text: Repeat `--cpg --modified-bases 5mC` when adding flags (e.g. `--cpg --modified-bases 5mC --combine-strands`). An empty value gives the unfiltered pileup of every modification code at every position: use `--modkit_args=''` (the `=` form) or an empty `modkit_args` entry in a params file, since `--modkit_args ''` reaches the pipeline as `true`. `--modified-bases` only filters the output: on PacBio data, positions where the 5mC and 5hmC probabilities sum above 1 are still dropped and non-conflicting 5hmC calls are counted in `N_other`.

modkit_phased.description: Run `modkit pileup --phased` on the Longphase-haplotagged BAMs, producing `<sample>_hp1.bed.gz`, `<sample>_hp2.bed.gz` and `<sample>_combined.bed.gz`. The pileup then requires small-variant calling, phasing and haplotagging to have succeeded for the sample.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

clairsto_cna_resources.description: Verdict CNA resource directory for ClairS-TO, holding loci_files/, allele_files/ and one GC_*.txt. Read only with --skip_ascat.
clairsto_cna_resources.help_text: Read only on `--skip_ascat` runs; otherwise Verdict's germline tagging comes from the pipeline's ASCAT run and this is ignored. The image ships the GRCh38 set and `--genome CHM13 --skip_ascat` builds a CHM13 one, so this is only needed for another assembly or as an override. The directory must be self-contained, with no links reaching outside it. Add an `RT_<name>.txt` to correct LogR for replication timing as well; without it, correction is GC-only.

vep_cache.help_text: Path to the directory containing the VEP cache. If you are using an iGenomes reference, this will be set automatically. Otherwise, you will need to provide this path yourself.

vep_args.description: Additional command line arguments to pass to VEP.

vep_cache_version.description: Version of the VEP cache to use.
vep_cache_version.help_text: The version of the VEP cache to use. This should match the version of VEP being used.

download_vep_cache.description: Download the VEP cache if not already present

vep_alphamissense.description: Path or URL to the AlphaMissense GRCh38 score file for the AlphaMissense plugin.
vep_alphamissense.help_text: Defaults to AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz (613 MB) from https://storage.googleapis.com/dm_alphamissense on --genome GRCh38, fetched with an index we host since the release ships without a .tbi. Supply this together with --vep_alphamissense_tbi to use a local copy instead. GRCh38 only; on CHM13 the route is --vep_alphamissense_aa. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

vep_alphamissense_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_alphamissense.
vep_alphamissense_tbi.help_text: Required whenever --vep_alphamissense is set. Overriding the score file drops the default index, which was built from different content.

vep_alphamissense_aa.description: Path or URL to a protein-space AlphaMissense table for the AlphaMissenseProtein plugin (CHM13).
vep_alphamissense_aa.help_text: Defaults on --genome CHM13 to a table we host (1.1 GB, indexed), built from the AlphaMissense protein-space release -- see CITATIONS.md. Keyed on gene symbol and amino-acid substitution, so it is assembly-independent, which is what makes AlphaMissense reachable on CHM13. Supply this with --vep_alphamissense_aa_tbi to use a table of your own.

vep_alphamissense_aa_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_alphamissense_aa.
vep_alphamissense_aa_tbi.help_text: Required whenever --vep_alphamissense_aa is set. Overriding the table drops the default index, which was built from different content.

vep_polyphen_sift_db.description: Path or URL to the Ensembl pangenome PolyPhen/SIFT SQLite database for the PolyPhen_SIFT plugin (CHM13).
vep_polyphen_sift_db.help_text: Defaults to homo_sapiens_pangenome_PolyPhen_SIFT_20240502.db (13 GB) from https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/variation/pangenomes/Human/ on --genome CHM13. Keyed on the MD5 of the peptide sequence, which is why it works on CHM13; on GRCh38 SIFT and PolyPhen come from the VEP cache and this is unused. It needs no preparation, so point at a local copy.

vep_clinvar.description: Path or URL to a ClinVar VCF, added as a VEP --custom annotation.
vep_clinvar.help_text: Defaults to the NCBI GRCh38 VCF on --genome GRCh38 and the CHM13-lifted Ensembl VCF on --genome CHM13, both with their published .tbi. Contig naming differs between NCBI (1, 2, 3) and the GATK GRCh38 reference (chr1, chr2, chr3); VEP usually reconciles this for --custom files, but a name it cannot map annotates nothing, so confirm CLNSIG values appear before trusting them.

vep_clinvar_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_clinvar.
vep_clinvar_tbi.help_text: Required whenever --vep_clinvar is set: ClinVar publishes a .tbi alongside every VCF, so the pipeline does not build one.

vep_clinvar_md5.description: Expected MD5 of the --vep_clinvar VCF, checked after the pipeline downloads it.
vep_clinvar_md5.help_text: A remote --vep_clinvar (http, https or ftp) is downloaded once per run by VEPPLUGIN_CLINVAR, rather than staged by GERMLINE_VEP and SOMATIC_VEP for every sample, and a VCF that does not match this MD5 fails the run, so the release cannot change silently. The GRCh38 and CHM13 defaults carry the MD5 their hosts publish; overriding --vep_clinvar drops it. A local or cloud-storage --vep_clinvar is staged as given, and takes no MD5.

vep_clinvar_tbi_md5.description: Expected MD5 of the --vep_clinvar_tbi index, checked after the pipeline downloads it.
vep_clinvar_tbi_md5.help_text: Checked alongside --vep_clinvar_md5. The CHM13 default carries the MD5 Ensembl publishes; GRCh38 has none, since NCBI publishes no checksum for its indexes. Overriding --vep_clinvar or --vep_clinvar_tbi drops the default.

vep_clinvar_fields.description: Comma-separated ClinVar INFO fields to carry into the annotation.

vep_cadd_snv.description: Path or URL to the CADD SNV score file for the CADD plugin.
vep_cadd_snv.help_text: Off by default: whole_genome_SNVs.tsv.gz from https://krishna.gs.washington.edu/download/CADD/v1.7/GRCh38/ is 81 GB and is re-staged on every run that is not a -resume. Set this with --vep_cadd_snv_tbi to enable it, ideally pointing at a local copy. GRCh38 only: CADD scores non-coding positions and has no protein-space form for CHM13. Free for non-commercial use only.

vep_cadd_snv_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_cadd_snv.
vep_cadd_snv_tbi.help_text: Required whenever --vep_cadd_snv is set: CADD publishes a .tbi alongside every score file.

vep_cadd_indel.description: Path or URL to the CADD indel score file for the CADD plugin.
vep_cadd_indel.help_text: Off by default, like --vep_cadd_snv. gnomad.genomes.r4.0.indel.tsv.gz (1.2 GB, .tbi published) lives in the same CADD release directory; set this with --vep_cadd_indel_tbi to enable it. GRCh38 only. Free for non-commercial use only.

vep_cadd_indel_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_cadd_indel.
vep_cadd_indel_tbi.help_text: Required whenever --vep_cadd_indel is set: CADD publishes a .tbi alongside every score file.

vep_revel.description: Path or URL to the REVEL release zip, or to a prepared score file, for the REVEL plugin.
vep_revel.help_text: Defaults to revel-v1.3_all_chromosomes.zip (667 MB) from https://rothsj06.dmz.hpc.mssm.edu on --genome GRCh38. Anything that is not already a bgzipped .tsv.gz (the release zip, a URL serving it, or an unpacked directory) is prepared for you; pass a prepared .tsv.gz with --vep_revel_tbi to use it directly. GRCh38 only. Free for non-commercial use only.

vep_revel_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_revel.
vep_revel_tbi.help_text: Required when --vep_revel points at an already-prepared .tsv.gz. Rejected when --vep_revel points at anything the pipeline has to reshape first, since the prep task indexes the file it writes and a supplied index could not apply to it.

vep_eve.description: Path or URL to the EVE release zip, or to a merged EVE VCF, for the EVE plugin.
vep_eve.help_text: Off by default: the release is a 9.6 GB zip of per-protein VCFs from https://evemodel.org/api/proteins/bulk/download/ that has to be merged. Anything that is not already a bgzipped .vcf.gz, including that URL, is prepared for you; pass a merged .vcf.gz with --vep_eve_tbi to use it directly. GRCh38 only. Free for non-commercial use only.

vep_eve_tbi.description: Path or URL to the index for --vep_eve.
vep_eve_tbi.help_text: Required when --vep_eve points at an already-merged .vcf.gz. Rejected when --vep_eve points at anything the pipeline has to merge first, since the prep task indexes the file it writes and a supplied index could not apply to it.

savana_pb_minsupport.description: Minimum supporting reads for SAVANA to call a variant on PacBio samples (--min_support with --pb). SAVANA's own testing found 10 outperforms its default of 5 on PacBio data.

savana_chromosomes.description: Restrict SAVANA's allele counting and binning to given chromosome numbers (SAVANA's -c/--chromosomes), e.g. '19'. Applies to both `savana cna` and `savana to`.

savana_allele_min_reads.description: Minimum reads per site for SAVANA to count a het-SNP allele (SAVANA's --allele_min_reads, default 10). Intended for test profiles running on downsampled data below that coverage floor.

savana_allele_mapq.description: Mapping quality threshold for reads counted at a het-SNP site (SAVANA's --allele_mapq, default 5). Intended for test profiles running on downsampled data below that coverage floor.

ascat_chroms.description: Chromosomes to process (automatically inferred, only use if you want to run on a subset)

ascat_pdf_plots.description: Boolean for ASCAT production of pdf plots (entered as string)

sigprofiler_genome_dir.description: SigProfilerMatrixGenerator volume directory containing tsb/<sigprofiler_genome>/ (the installed genome payload).
sigprofiler_genome_dir.help_text: Create it once with `--download_sigprofiler_genome` (published to `<outdir>/cache/sigprofiler/volume`) or with `SigProfilerMatrixGenerator install <genome> --volume <dir>`, then pass it here on later runs.

download_sigprofiler_genome.description: Download and install the ~3 GB SigProfilerMatrixGenerator genome payload during the run instead of using --sigprofiler_genome_dir.

sigprofiler_cosmic_version.description: COSMIC reference signature version fitted by SigProfilerAssignment.

sigprofiler_exclude_signature_subgroups.description: Comma-separated SigProfilerAssignment signature subgroups to exclude from the fit (e.g. `Artifact_signatures,Lymphoid_signatures`).

report_options.title: Report options
report_options.description: Options for the final per-sample HTML report

report_gene_panel.description: Gene panel(s) applied when the report opens, as a comma-separated list: 'none' for no filtering, builtin panel names (e.g. 'lymphoid'), and/or paths to TSVs with a 'gene' column. Several panels are unioned; default (unset) is unfiltered.
report_gene_panel.help_text: Every builtin panel is embedded in the report as a checkbox, so this only sets the initial selection. An entry is read as a panel file if it contains a '/' or ends in '.tsv', and as a builtin panel name otherwise. 'none' cannot be combined with a real panel, and two panel files sharing a base name cannot be combined.

skip_options.title: Skip options
skip_options.description: Define whether to skip certain steps

skip_bamstats.description: Skips samtools flagstat, stats, and idxstats

skip_ascat.description: Skip ASCAT. ClairS-TO's Verdict germline tagging of tumour-only calls then uses Verdict's own purity and copy number estimate instead of ASCAT's.

skip_vep_plugins.description: Skip the VEP plugin annotation, keeping the rest of VEP
skip_vep_plugins.help_text: Annotate with VEP alone, downloading no plugin data. Plugins are on by default on --genome GRCh38 (about 1.4 GB on a first run) and --genome CHM13 (about 14 GB, mostly the pangenome PolyPhen/SIFT database); CADD and EVE are opt-in. --igenomes_ignore and a non-human --genome also leave the plugins off.

skip_normalfiber.description: Skip Fibertools steps for the normal sample

skip_modcall.description: Skip Longphase `modcall`, the 5mC base-modification calling whose VCF is used as extra evidence during phasing. Unrelated to the modkit pileup (see `skip_modkit`).

use_gpu.description: Use GPU for supported tools (e.g. DeepVariant, DeepSomatic, Clair3)

skip_report.description: Skip the final per-sample HTML report

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
